content.short: Swiss digital asset advisory running curated lending vaults, managed strategies and risk markets.
content.description: Telos Consilium, founded in 2023 and based in Switzerland, sits between institutions and DeFi. It curates lending vaults for real-world and DeFi assets, setting collateral parameters and sourcing liquidity, builds risk infrastructure that lets asset managers price and transfer risk, and advises protocols on strategy, incentives and smart contracts. It has launched more than 20 products.
